comparison.objective: Add and close a personal padlock through a free hole of an occupied group-lockout hasp.
comparison.physical_skill: Shackle-to-hole insertion and latching without disturbing an existing lock or energized-control state.
comparison.success_condition: Purple lock shut and independently retains the hasp under pry and handle-load tests; coworker lock remains undisturbed.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-preserving insertion, closure, and load retention, not controlled fracture and containment.
